items.source: State-changing HTTP methods and other HTTP conditional request headers such as If-Match and If-Unmodified-Since are outside the scope of this filter. Please consider using ServletWebRequest.checkNotModified(String, long) instead.
items.translation: 状态变更的 HTTP 方法以及其他 HTTP 条件请求头（如`If-Match`和`If-Unmodified-Since`）不在该过滤器范围内。请考虑改用ServletWebRequest.checkNotModified(String, long)。

items.source: Since the ETag is based on the response content, the response (for example, a View) is still rendered. As such, this filter only saves bandwidth, not server performance.
items.translation: 由于 ETag 基于响应内容，因此响应（例如一个View）仍然会被渲染。因此，此过滤器仅节省带宽，而非服务器性能。

items.source: Should be configured using an <init-param> for parameter name "writeWeakETag" in the filter definition in web.xml.
items.translation: 应使用 `<init-param>` 在 `web.xml` 中的过滤器定义里配置参数名称为 "writeWeakETag"。

items.source: Note: This method must be called before the response is written to in order for the entire response content to be written without caching.
items.translation: 注意： 必须在向响应写入之前调用此方法，以确保整个响应内容能够无缓存地写入。

items.source: The default implementation generates an MD5 hash.
items.translation: 默认实现生成一个 MD5 哈希值。

items.source:
Whether an ETag should be calculated for the given request and response exchange. By default, this is true if all the following match:
  • Response is not committed.
  • Response status codes is in the 2xx series.
  • Request method is a GET.
  • Response Cache-Control header does not contain "no-store" (or is not present at all).
items.translation:
是否应为给定的请求和响应交换计算 ETag。默认情况下，如果满足以下所有条件，则为 true：
  • 响应未提交。
  • 响应状态码属于 2xx 系列。
  • 请求方法为 GET。
  • 响应 Cache-Control 头不包含 "no-store"（或根本不存在）。

items.source: The default value is false so that the filter may delay the generation of an ETag until the last asynchronously dispatched thread.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`，以便过滤器可以将 ETag 的生成延迟到最后一个异步调度的线程。

items.translation: 返回根据 RFC 7232，写入响应的 ETag 值是否应为弱验证。
